cues: Herbert George Wells was born in eighteen sixty six to a poor family in Kent.
Apprenticed as a draper at thirteen, he hated it, won a scholarship, and studied biology under Thomas Huxley, Darwin's great defender.
This story appeared in a London magazine in eighteen ninety four, when he was twenty seven.
Within four years he had written The Time Machine, The Invisible Man and The War of the Worlds, and became a father of science fiction.
